Then he shut it and put it in his pocket, and Kiva saw that he had not looked at the time at all. He had only wanted to hold something. On Saturday morning at ten, Kiva went along the long quay to the counting house, because the proprietor had asked her to, buy a card in his own hand, that came to the loft on Friday night.
